remarks: Welcome to 2 Maplewood Terrace, Unit #1! This first-floor unit features 3 bedrooms, 1 full bath and over 1,200 SQFT. It also offers a large living room with a fireplace. Beautiful hardwood floors throughout, and a fresh paint job. New fridge and dishwasher, also a newer gas range. Rear patio area reserved for the 1st floor tenant, and a backyard for shared use amongst both tenants. Off-street parking in front of the house for 1 Car, and additional street parking. Quiet side road off of Main Ave. Gas station, pharmacy, restaurants, shopping, and bus stop in walking distance. No washer or dryer; Giant Laundry 1 minute away on Main Ave. Basement and Garage are reserved for the Landlord. Close to Rt-7 Connector to i-95, and to Merrit Parkway. Available Immediately. Good Credit is a Must, Proof of legal source of income, 2 months of paystubs for most recent 2 months of work. Please use RentSpree for credit report. This means all adults 18+. Please include legal ID for all adults with offers. Please submit offers as a single pdf file.
